fields.label: Developer mode
fields.help: Follow the latest commit on a GitHub branch instead of releases. Settings › better-unas then offers each new commit as an update. For testing unreleased changes; turn it off to go back to releases on the next update.

fields.label: Branch
fields.help: The branch developer mode follows, e.g. main or a pull request's branch. Enter lists the branches on GitHub to pick from.

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.help: Where every tool's alerts go, e.g. an ntfy topic or a Slack or Discord webhook. Empty: alerts go only to the system log.

fields.label: Webhook format
fields.help: How alerts are sent. text is a plain body, which ntfy and most receivers take.

fields.label: Notify on success
fields.help: Also send a message when things go well, such as a passed SMART test. UniFi already shows those.

fields.label: Repeat alerts every
fields.help: Send a still-active alert again after this many hours.

fields.label: Heartbeat URL
fields.help: Pinged each time a tool's scheduled check ends without errors, so a monitor such as healthchecks.io or Uptime Kuma notices when the pings stop.

fields.label: Heartbeat URL on failure
fields.help: Optional: pinged instead of the heartbeat when a tool's scheduled check ends with errors.
